```{r}
df_param<-read_csv(file.path(base_path,"Scenarios/Way paper/energy_system_model/parameters/tech_params.csv"),col_names = T)
df_lifespan<-
  df_param%>%
  rename("variable"="...1")%>%
  filter(variable=="Lifespan (years)")%>%
  select(-variable)%>%
  gather(key=energy,value=lifespan)%>%
  mutate(lifespan=as.numeric(lifespan))%>%
  mutate(energy=case_when(
    energy=="oil_final"~"oil",
    energy=="coal_final"~"solid",
    energy=="gas_final"~"gas",
    energy=="coal_electricity"~"elec_coal",
    energy=="gas_electricity"~"elec_unabated_gas",
    energy=="nuclear_electricity"~"Nuclear",
    energy=="hydro_electricity"~"elec_other_hydro",
    energy=="bioenergy_electricity"~"elec_biomass",
    energy=="wind_electricity"~"wind_offshore",
    energy=="solar_electricity"~"solar",
    str_detect(energy,"batteries") & str_detect(energy,"electricity")~"storage",
    energy=="hydrogen"~"hydrogen"
  ))%>%
  filter(!is.na(energy))%>%
  group_by(energy)%>%
  summarise(lifespan=mean(lifespan))
```

Note that the primary energy consumption of the CCC includes the quantities used for electricity production. We want to use the final energy mix, that is that the gas used to produce electricity is not accounted for, but the generated electricity is. From the gas demand, we subtract the quantity of electricity produced by gas -- unabated gas, CCS gas and CHP gas ---, we subtract biomass electricity (with and without CCS) to bioenergy, and hydrogen generated electricity are subtracted to hydrogen. We assume a conversion factor of 0.5 for gas and hydrogen, and 0.4 for coal following \cite{wayEmpiricallyGroundedTechnology2022}\footnote{SI 2.6, p33.}, meaning that we divide the quantity of electricity by 0.5 (or 0.4) to get the required primary energy quantity. We assume the same yield for biomass than for coal. 
```{r}

remove_double_counting_primary_q_CCC <- function(dq_raw) {
  
 factor_primary_final<-
   df_x_primary_final%>%
   spread(key=energy,value=x_primary_to_final)
  
  dq_raw %>%
    mutate(
      # remove double counting
      gas       = gas - elec_unabated_gas/factor_primary_final$gas - elec_gas_CCS/factor_primary_final$gas - elec_other_gasCHP/factor_primary_final$gas,
      bioenergy = bioenergy - elec_biomass/factor_primary_final$bioenergy - elec_biomass_CCS/factor_primary_final$bioenergy,
      hydrogen  = hydrogen - elec_hydrogen/factor_primary_final$hydrogen
    )

}

```


Note that for Way et al we have prices in USD/MWh but quantities in EJ, we need to convert them to get accurate sales
1 Terawatt Hour = 0.0036 Exajoules
1EJ=277.78 TWh
```{r}

convert_EJ_to_TWh<-function(df){
  df%>%
    mutate(value=ifelse(variable=="q",value/0.0036,value))
  }
```


Conversion factor final -> useful

\[Q_{\text{useful}}=xQ_{\text{final}}\]
with $x<1$, and price
\[p_{\text{useful}}=\frac{p_{\text{final}}}{x}\]
with $x<1$. 

Convert primary to final
\[Q_{\text{final}}=xQ_{\text{primary}}\]
with $x<1$, and price
\[p_{\text{final}}=\frac{p_{\text{primary}}}{x}\]
with $x<1$. 


$x=1$ for elec, 
$x=0.5$ for oil, gas, hydrogen
$x=0.6$ for solid, non_bio_waste, bioenergy

```{r}
# We use it for Way
convert_p_final_to_useful <- function(df_merged) {
if("x_final_useful" %in% colnames(df_merged)){
    df_merged<-
      df_merged%>%select(-x_final_useful)
  }
  
  df_merged %>%
   left_join(df_x_final_useful,by="energy")%>%
    mutate(value=ifelse(variable=="p",value/x_final_useful,value))
}



convert_final_to_useful <- function(df_merged) {
  
  if("x_final_useful" %in% colnames(df_merged)){
    df_merged<-
      df_merged%>%select(-x_final_useful)
  }
  
# for oil, gas, coal, bioenergy and H2, the conversion factor is from primary to useful
  df_merged %>%
   left_join(df_x_final_useful,by="energy")%>%
    mutate(value=ifelse(variable=="p",value/x_final_useful,value),
           value=ifelse(variable=="q",value*x_final_useful,value))
}

convert_useful_to_final <- function(df_merged) {
# for oil, gas, coal, bioenergy and H2, the conversion factor is from primary to useful
  
  if("x_final_useful" %in% colnames(df_merged)){
    df_merged<-
      df_merged%>%select(-x_final_useful)
  }
  df_merged %>%
   left_join(df_x_final_useful,by="energy")%>%
    mutate(value=ifelse(variable=="p",value*x_final_useful,value),
           value=ifelse(variable=="q",value/x_final_useful,value))
  }
```



The energy provided in the CCC and in Way et al is already in final energy:
electricity is electricity, no matter its source, and the price reflects how it was produced
likewise, raw fossil fuel are the ones used directly by the industries, 
no need to convert them. 
```{r}
convert_primary_to_final <- function(df_merged) {
print("Conversion Primary to final electricity has been deactivated.")
  df_merged  %>%
   left_join(df_x_primary_final,by="energy")%>%
    mutate(x_primary_to_final=ifelse(is.na(x_primary_to_final),1,x_primary_to_final))%>%
    mutate(value=ifelse(variable=="p",value/x_primary_to_final,value),
           value=ifelse(variable=="q",value*x_primary_to_final,value))
  }



```

# Compute vintage cost


For a tech with lifespan L > 0, each cohort contributes a constant annual output $k_b$ for L years after build year b.

Then totals satisfy a renewal identity:
$q_t = k_t + k_{t-1} + … + k_{t-L+1}$.
We can recover the implied cohort outputs recursively:
$k_t = q_t − (k_{t-1} + … + k_{t-L+1})$.


```{r}
# Reconstruct cohort outputs from annual totals (no decay), then price them by build-year p
# Inputs:
#   df_q:  Year, energy, Scenario_q, q        (ANNUAL TOTAL OUTPUT per tech)
#   df_p:  Year, energy, Scenario_p (opt), p  (MARGINAL COST per tech-year)
#   df_lifespan: energy, lifespan (integer years; 0 => marginal-only)
# Output: Year, Scenario_q, energy, p_vintage
compute_vintage_price <- function(df_q, df_p,
                                  match_p_q = TRUE,
                                  keep_components = FALSE,
                                  clamp_negative_k = TRUE) {
  # Basic prep
  dq <- df_q %>% select(Year, energy, Scenario_q, q) %>% mutate(q = as.numeric(q))
  dp <- df_p %>% select(Year, energy, any_of("Scenario_p"), p) %>% mutate(p = as.numeric(p))
  L  <- df_lifespan %>% transmute(energy, lifespan = as.integer(lifespan))

  # Split techs
  L0   <- L %>% filter(lifespan == 0L) %>% distinct(energy)
  Lpos <- L %>% filter(lifespan  > 0L) %>% distinct(energy, lifespan)

  # ---- Case A: lifespan > 0  → infer cohort outputs k_t from totals q_t
  infer_k <- function(q_vec, L) {
    n <- length(q_vec); k <- numeric(n)
    for (t in seq_len(n)) {
      # sum of previous L-1 cohorts that are still alive at t
      lookback <- max(0, min(L-1, t-1))
      if (lookback > 0) {
        k[t] <- q_vec[t] - sum(k[(t-lookback):(t-1)])
      } else {
        k[t] <- q_vec[t]
      }
      if (clamp_negative_k && !is.na(k[t]) && k[t] < 0) k[t] <- 0
    }
    k
  }

  # Build implied cohort outputs per (energy, Scenario_q)
  k_long <- dq %>%
    semi_join(Lpos, by = "energy") %>%
    left_join(Lpos, by = "energy") %>%
    group_by(energy, Scenario_q) %>%
    arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(k_build = infer_k(q, unique(lifespan))) %>%  # k at build year = Annual output of new cohort
    ungroup()

  # Expand each cohort to its alive years (b .. b+L-1) and use k_build as weight
  w_alive <- k_long %>%
    rename(BuildYear = Year) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(UseYears = list(seq.int(BuildYear, BuildYear + lifespan - 1L))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    unnest(UseYears) %>%
    transmute(Year = UseYears, energy, Scenario_q, BuildYear, w = k_build)

  # Join build-year prices and compute vintage-weighted price
  if (nrow(w_alive) > 0) {
    if (match_p_q) {
      w_alive <- w_alive %>%
        left_join(dp %>% rename(BuildYear = Year),
                  by = c("BuildYear","energy","Scenario_q" = "Scenario_p"))
    } else {
      w_alive <- w_alive %>%
        left_join(dp %>% rename(BuildYear = Year),
                  by = c("BuildYear","energy"))
    }

    p_vint_pos <- w_alive %>%
      filter(is.finite(p), is.finite(w)) %>%
      group_by(Year, Scenario_q, energy) %>%
      summarise(p_vintage = if (sum(w) == 0) NA_real_ else stats::weighted.mean(p, w),
                .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    p_vint_pos <- tibble::tibble(Year=integer(), Scenario_q=character(), energy=character(), p_vintage=double())
  }

  # ---- Case B: lifespan == 0  → marginal-only (current-year p)
  dq_0 <- dq %>% semi_join(L0, by = "energy")
  if (nrow(dq_0) > 0) {
    if (match_p_q) {
      dq0_join <- dq_0 %>% left_join(dp, by = c("Year","energy","Scenario_q" = "Scenario_p"))
    } else {
      dq0_join <- dq_0 %>% left_join(dp, by = c("Year","energy"))
    }
    p_vint_0 <- dq0_join %>%
      filter(is.finite(p), is.finite(q)) %>%
      group_by(Year, Scenario_q, energy) %>%
      summarise(p_vintage = stats::weighted.mean(p, q), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    p_vint_0 <- tibble::tibble(Year=integer(), Scenario_q=character(), energy=character(), p_vintage=double())
  }

  # ---- Combine
  out <- bind_rows(p_vint_pos, p_vint_0) %>% arrange(Year, Scenario_q, energy)%>%
    rename(Scenario_p=Scenario_q)

  if (keep_components) {
    return(list(p_vintage = out,
                implied_cohorts = k_long %>% select(energy, Scenario_q, Year = BuildYear, k_build),
                weights_alive = w_alive))
  } else {
    return(out)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# --- Vintage-aware merge + system average price (mirrors your helper) ----------
# This returns a df like your merged frame (Year/Scenario_q/variable/value)
# where 'p' is replaced by vintage-adjusted prices, and it also computes
# the average price across energies weighted by current-year q.
merge_price_quantity_and_add_network <- function(df_q, df_p, cost_add = 7,match_p_q=F,overgeneration=1.6) {
  print("Prices must be vintage adjusted")
  # ratio is for wind/solar only
  df_ratio <- calculate_wind_solar_ratio(df_q)

  df_p<-
    df_p%>%
     mutate(p=ifelse(energy %in% c("solar","wind"),p*overgeneration,p))
  
  if(match_p_q){
    df_pq<-df_q %>%
    left_join(df_p, by = c("Year"="Year", "energy"="energy","Scenario_q"="Scenario_p"))
  }else{
    df_pq<-df_q %>%
    left_join(df_p, by = c("Year", "energy"))
  }
out<-df_pq%>%
    left_join(df_ratio, by = c("Year","Scenario_q")) %>%
    mutate(ratio_2022 = ifelse(is.na(ratio_2022), 0, ratio_2022)) %>%
    # add the cost
    mutate(p = ifelse(energy %in% c("solar", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore"),p + cost_add * ratio_2022,p)) %>%
    tidyr::gather(key = "variable", value = "value", c("p", "q"))
return(out)

}
```


# Storage

## Electricity hydrogen

We read the share of electricity from hydrogen from the output of the Way et al code, 
see the read me sheet in the excel for the details

We then transform it into hydrogen quantity needed with 
hydrogen_to_elec_efficiency = 0.5  

We then transform it into the capacity needed of electrolyser: 
Capacity C of electrolyser
E is the quantity of hydrogen needed

\[C=\frac{E}{8760\times 0.5\times 0.7}\]

0.7 is the electrolyser efficiency to transform electricity in hydrogen
0.5 is the average utilisation rate (not in the old code, but SI p44)
8760 transform EJ/year into EJ/hour (capacity)

```{r}
# Careful: only for Fast Transition!
final_elec_from_hydrogen_share_Fast_Transition<-
  read_excel(file.path(energy_path,"final_elec_from_hydrogen_share.xlsx"),sheet="fast_transition")
final_elec_from_hydrogen_share_Slow_Transition<-
  read_excel(file.path(energy_path,"final_elec_from_hydrogen_share.xlsx"),sheet="slow_transition")
final_elec_from_hydrogen_share_No_Transition<-
  read_excel(file.path(energy_path,"final_elec_from_hydrogen_share.xlsx"),sheet="no_transition")

final_elec_from_hydrogen_share<-
  rbind(final_elec_from_hydrogen_share_Fast_Transition%>%mutate(Scenario_q="Fast_Transition"),
        final_elec_from_hydrogen_share_Slow_Transition%>%mutate(Scenario_q="Slow_Transition"),
        final_elec_from_hydrogen_share_No_Transition%>%mutate(Scenario_q="No_Transition"))


final_elec_from_hydrogen_share%>%
  filter(Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition",year==2050)

```

## Quantities storage

```{r}
prepare_quantity_data_way<-function(dq_raw){
 df<-dq_raw
 
  factor_primary_final<-
   df_x_primary_final%>%
   spread(key=energy,value=x_primary_to_final)
  
    df<-df%>%
    left_join(final_elec_from_hydrogen_share,by=c("Year"="year","Scenario_q"))%>%
      spread(key=energy,value=q)%>%
    # Compute storage capacity 
    mutate(storage=(solar+wind_offshore)*1.5*0.3/365,
           elec_hydrogen= final_elec_from_hydrogen_share*(solar+wind_offshore),
               # See Figure S8-I, p57 of SI, the P2X fuel for sector is about 80EJ in 2050, which is the value reported in the scenarios. 
           # hydroen for elec is additional
           # hydrogen  = hydrogen - elec_hydrogen/factor_primary_final$hydrogen

    )%>%
      select(-final_elec_from_hydrogen_share)%>%
      tidyr::gather(key = "energy", value = "q", -c("Scenario_q","Year")) %>%
dplyr::filter(! energy %in% c("all_elec", "total")) %>%
mutate(q = as.numeric(q))

  
 cap_storage_growth(df)%>%
    dplyr::filter(! energy %in% c("all_elec", "total")) %>%
    mutate(q = as.numeric(q))%>%
    spread(key=energy,value=q)%>%
   # transforming capacity into energy stored
   mutate(storage=storage*365)%>%
      tidyr::gather(key = "energy", value = "q", -c("Scenario_q","Year"))
   
 
  
}

dplyr::filter(! energy %in% c("all_elec", "total")) %>%

}
```

```{r}
# in Way et al code, we use the minimum of the requirement of storage (30% of the wind and solar electricity generated) or a 
# cap to 60% (ST) or 80% (LT) growth rate of the available capacity 
# short term (daily) grid storage: initial very fast growth then is capped at given fraction of daily wind + solar
    

# Initial levels
# ST  2.5GWh (2018)
elec_storage_batt_ST_electricity_0<-2.5
# convert into TWh, then into EJ
elec_storage_batt_ST_electricity_0<-elec_storage_batt_ST_electricity_0/1000*0.0036
# LT : 0.12GWh  (2018)
elec_storage_batt_LT_electricity_0<-0.12
elec_storage_batt_LT_electricity_0<-elec_storage_batt_LT_electricity_0/1000*0.0036

# df_q%>%
  # filter(Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition", Year==2050, energy=="storage")

cap_storage_growth<-function(df_q){
  
  years_range<-seq(2018,2070)
  
  # 2018 to 2070, cut to 2020-2070
  q_ST<-tibble(Year=years_range,"q_ST"=elec_storage_batt_ST_electricity_0 * (1 + 0.6)^(c(1:53) + 1))
  q_LT<-tibble(Year=years_range,"q_LT"=elec_storage_batt_LT_electricity_0 * (1 + 0.8)^(c(1:53) + 1))
 
  cols_fin<-colnames(df_q %>%select(-"energy",-"q"))
  
  q_storage<-df_q%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    filter(energy=="storage")%>%
    spread(key=energy,value=q)%>%
    mutate(q_fraction_ST=1/3*storage,
          q_fraction_LT=2/3*storage)%>%
    left_join(q_LT,by="Year")%>%
      left_join(q_ST,by="Year")%>%
    rowwise()%>%
    mutate(q_fraction_ST=min(q_fraction_ST,q_ST),
           q_fraction_LT=min(q_fraction_LT,q_LT))%>%
    mutate(storage=q_fraction_LT+q_fraction_ST)%>%
    select(all_of(cols_fin),storage)

  # rejoin
    df_q%>%
     spread(key=energy,value=q)%>%
    select(-storage)%>%
    left_join(q_storage)%>%
    gather(key=energy,value=q,-c(cols_fin))
  
}
```



## Network cost

```{r}
# Calculate ratio above 2022 for wind/solar, to apply additional network cost
calculate_wind_solar_ratio <- function(df_q) {

  # Q in 2022 (what the current grid can deal with)
  df_q2022 <- df_q %>%
    filter(Year == 2022) %>%
     filter(energy %in% c("solar", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore")) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q)%>%
    summarise(q2022 = sum(q))

  # Merge and compute ratio
  df_ratio <- df_q %>%
    filter(energy %in% c("solar", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore")) %>%
     group_by(Year,Scenario_q)%>%
    summarise(q = sum(q))%>%
    left_join(df_q2022, by = c("Scenario_q")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(ratio_2022 = max(0, (q - q2022) / q)) %>%
    select(Scenario_q, Year, ratio_2022)

  df_ratio
}

# Merge Q & P with the network cost tweak
merge_price_quantity_and_add_network <- function(df_q, df_p, cost_add = 7,match_p_q=F) {
  # ratio is for wind/solar only
  df_ratio <- calculate_wind_solar_ratio(df_q)

  if(match_p_q){
    df_pq<-df_q %>%
    left_join(df_p, by = c("Year"="Year", "energy"="energy","Scenario_q"="Scenario_p"))
  }else{
    df_pq<-df_q %>%
    left_join(df_p, by = c("Year", "energy"))
  }
df_pq%>%
    left_join(df_ratio, by = c("Year","Scenario_q")) %>%
    mutate(ratio_2022 = ifelse(is.na(ratio_2022), 0, ratio_2022)) %>%
    # add the cost
    mutate(p = ifelse(energy %in% c("solar", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore"),p + cost_add * ratio_2022,p)) %>%
    tidyr::gather(key = "variable", value = "value", c("p", "q"))


}

                      "elec_other_gasCHP", "wind_offshore", "wind_onshore",
                      "solar", "elec_other_hydro", "elec_coal", "storage",
                      # if already changed names
                      
      "Gas electricity","Gas+CCS electricity",
      "Gas+coal electricity",
      "Biomass electricity","Biomass+CCS electricity",
      "Coal electricity","Hydrogen electricity",
      "Hydro-electricity","Nuclear",
      "Offshore Wind electricity","Onshore Wind electricity",
      "Solar PV electricity","Storage"
                      ),
        "elec", "non_elec"
      )
    )
    
  
}
```

## Summaries & Productivity

```{r}
transform_bp_into_pp<-function(x){
  return(exp(x)-1)
}

# Compute total sales by scenario-year
compute_sales <- function(df_merged,exch_rate) {
  df_merged %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    spread(key = "variable", value = "value") %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q, Year) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p) & !is.na(q))%>%
    summarise(
      sales = sum(p * q * 1e6 / exch_rate),.groups = "drop")
}



# Compute Domar weight in a given year
compute_domar <- function(df_merged,
                          Year_select=2022,
                          # Global variables unless specified otherwise for 2022
                          gdp_year=GDP_UK,
                          exch_rate=1) {
  
  df_merged<-
    df_merged%>%
    ungroup()
    
  df_sales<-
    compute_sales(df_merged,exch_rate)
  
  df_sales %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(domar = sales / gdp_year)%>%
    filter(Year==Year_select)%>%
    select(domar)
}

# Compute log changes in weighted price (p) and total Q, then A-hat
compute_Ahat <- function(df_merged, zeta_value = zeta, start_year = 2022) {
  df_ah <- df_merged %>%
    filter(Year >= start_year)%>%
    spread(key = "variable", value = "value") %>%
    group_by(Year, Scenario_q) %>%
    summarise(
      p = weighted.mean(p, q, na.rm = TRUE),
      q = sum(q, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q) %>%
    arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      qhat = log(q) - log(dplyr::lag(q)),
      phat = log(p) - log(dplyr::lag(p)),
      Ahat = zeta_value * qhat + (zeta_value - 1) * phat
    ) 
  
  df_ah
}

# Compute cumulative sum of A-hat from a reference year
compute_cumulative_Ahat <- function(df_ah) {
  df_ah %>%
    filter(! is.na(Ahat)) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q) %>%
    mutate(cum_Ahat = cumsum(Ahat)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Decomposition of A-hat into volume effect vs price effect
compute_ahat_decomposition <- function(df_merged, zeta_value = zeta, start_year = 2022, year_stop=2050) {
  df_dec <- df_merged %>%
    filter(Year >= start_year)%>%
    spread(key = "variable", value = "value") %>%
    group_by(Year, Scenario_q) %>%
    summarise(
      p = weighted.mean(p, q, na.rm = TRUE),
      q = sum(q, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q) %>%
    arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE)%>%
    mutate(
      qhat = log(q) - log(dplyr::lag(q)),
      phat = log(p) - log(dplyr::lag(p)),
      Ahat = zeta_value * qhat + (zeta_value - 1) * phat,
      Ahat_p = (zeta_value - 1) * phat,
      Ahat_q = zeta_value * qhat
    ) %>%
     filter(! is.na(Ahat) & !is.na(Ahat_p)) %>%
    group_by(Scenario_q) %>%
    mutate(
      cum_Ahat_p = cumsum(Ahat_p),
      cum_Ahat_q = cumsum(Ahat_q),
      cum_Ahat   = cumsum(Ahat)
    )%>%ungroup()
  df_dec%>%filter(Year==year_stop)%>%select(Scenario_q,Year,cum_Ahat_q,cum_Ahat_p,cum_Ahat)
}

extract_TFP_energy<-function(df,Year_TFP=2050,quartiles=F,df_error=df_quantiles_error_extended){
   
  
  df_aihat<-compute_Ahat(df)
  
  df<-df_aihat%>%
    filter(!is.na(Ahat))%>%
     filter(Year <= Year_TFP)%>%
    mutate(cum_Ahat=cumsum(Ahat))%>%
    left_join(df_error%>%mutate(Year=2022+horizon),by="Year")%>%
    mutate(q10=cum_Ahat+q10,
           q25=cum_Ahat+q25,
           q75=cum_Ahat+q75,
           q90=cum_Ahat+q90)%>%
  filter(Year==Year_TFP)%>%
  mutate(cum_hat_pp=transform_bp_into_pp(cum_Ahat),
         q10_pp=transform_bp_into_pp(q10),
         q25_pp=transform_bp_into_pp(q25),
         q75_pp=transform_bp_into_pp(q75),
         q90_pp=transform_bp_into_pp(q90))
  
 if(quartiles){
   df%>%
  select(Scenario_q,cum_hat_pp,
         q10_pp,q25_pp ,q75_pp,q90_pp)
 }else{
   df%>%
  select(Scenario_q,cum_hat_pp)
 }
  }

extract_TFP_energy_logbp<-function(df,Year_TFP=2050,quartiles=F,df_error=df_quantiles_error_extended){
   df_aihat<-compute_Ahat(df)

df<-df_aihat%>%
    filter(!is.na(Ahat))%>%
     filter(Year <= Year_TFP)%>%
    mutate(cum_Ahat=cumsum(Ahat))%>%
    left_join(df_error%>%mutate(Year=2022+horizon),by="Year")%>%
    mutate(q10=cum_Ahat+q10,
           q25=cum_Ahat+q25,
           q75=cum_Ahat+q75,
           q90=cum_Ahat+q90)%>%
  filter(Year==Year_TFP)%>%
  mutate(cum_hat_logbp=cum_Ahat*10000,
         q10_logbp=q10*10000,
         q90_logbp=q90*10000,
         q25_logbp=q25*10000,

if(quartiles){

         q10_logbp,q25_logbp ,q75_logbp,q90_logbp)
 }else{
   df%>%
  select(Scenario_q,cum_hat_logbp)
 }
}

compute_impact_agg_economy<-function(df,GDP,exchange_rate,Year_TFP=2050){

  
df_domar <- compute_domar(df,
                              gdp_year = GDP,
                              exch_rate = exchange_rate)
df_aihat<-compute_Ahat(df)
df_cumAihat<-compute_cumulative_Ahat(df_aihat)

return(compute_impact_agg_economy_sub(df_cumAihat,df_domar,Year_TFP))

}

compute_impact_agg_economy_sub<-function(df,df_domar,Year_TFP=2050){

df_2050TFP<-
  df%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(Year==Year_TFP)%>%
   select(Scenario_q,cum_Ahat)%>%
  mutate(domar=df_domar$domar)%>%
  mutate(cum_hat_agg=cum_Ahat*domar,
         cum_hat_agg_year=cum_hat_agg/(Year_TFP-2022))%>%
  mutate(cum_hat_pp_agg=transform_bp_into_pp(cum_hat_agg),
         cum_hat_pp_agg_year=transform_bp_into_pp(cum_hat_agg_year))


impact<-(df_2050TFP%>% select(Scenario_q,cum_hat_pp_agg,cum_hat_pp_agg_year))

df_impact<-
  c("Agg impact %"=impact$cum_hat_pp_agg,
    "Agg impact pp"=impact$cum_hat_pp_agg*100,
    "Agg impact pp/year"=impact$cum_hat_pp_agg_year*100)


return(df_impact)
}
```

```{r}
save_tab_Ahat_decomposition<-function(df){
tab_log_pp<-compute_ahat_decomposition(df)%>%
  left_join(compute_c_agg_impact(df))


tab_log_pp
tab_pp<-tab_log_pp %>%
  mutate(across(c(cum_Ahat_p,cum_Ahat_q,cum_Ahat,agg_impact), transform_bp_into_pp))
tab_pp

# Join the two tables first
tab_joined <- tab_log_pp %>%
  left_join(tab_pp, by = c("Year", "Scenario_q"), suffix = c("_log", "_pp"))

# Define the target columns to combine
columns_to_format <- c("cum_Ahat_q", "cum_Ahat_p", "cum_Ahat","agg_impact")

# Loop and format
for (col in columns_to_format) {
  log_col <- paste0(col, "_log")
  pp_col <- paste0(col, "_pp")
  if(col=="agg_impact"){
    tab_joined[[col]] <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", tab_joined[[log_col]], tab_joined[[pp_col]])
  }else{
  tab_joined[[col]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", tab_joined[[log_col]], tab_joined[[pp_col]])}
}

# Keep only relevant columns
tab_combined_logpp_pp <- tab_joined %>%
  select(Scenario_q, all_of(columns_to_format)) %>%
  mutate(Scenario_q = stringr::str_replace_all(Scenario_q, "_", " "))

# Result
tab_combined_logpp_pp


colnames(tab_combined_logpp_pp) <- c(
  "Scenario",
  "$\\zeta\\hat{X}_{it}$",
  "$(\\zeta-1)\\hat{p}_{it}$",
  "$\\hat{A}_{it}$",
  "$\\hat{A}_t=\\lambda_i\\hat{A}_{it}$"
  
)
tab_combined_logpp_pp
}
```

```{r}
plot_energy_mix <- function(df_merged, 
                            scenario_filter = "Balanced Net Zero Pathway",
                            start_year = 2021, end_year = 2050,
                            max_q=NA,
                            is_useful=F) {
  # Filter for Q only and scenario
  df_q <- df_merged %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    filter(variable == "q", Scenario_q == scenario_filter, 
           Year >= start_year, Year <= end_year)
  
 
  # If we are in the UK, the Unut is TWh, and the scale goes up to 2000 TWh.
  # Global is in EJ, max is 650 EJ.
  # q_lim<-ifelse(unique(df_q$Unit)=="TWh",2000,650)
  
  # A pattern field for “elec vs non_elec”
  df_q <- add_is_elec(df_q)
   
  
    df_q<-rename_energy(df_q)
    
    # filter the colours present in the data set
  present_colours <- energy_colours[names(energy_colours) %in% unique(df_q$energy)]
  nb_elec<-n_distinct(df_q%>%filter(is_elec=="elec")%>%select(energy))
  nb_notelec<-n_distinct(df_q%>%filter(!is_elec=="elec")%>%select(energy))
  
  
  # Label
  unit=unique(df_q$Unit)
  if (is_useful) {
    y_label <- paste0("Useful energy (",unit,")")}else{
      y_label<-paste0("Final energy (",unit,")")
    }
  
  # Plot
  g <-
  df_q%>% filter(!is.na(value))%>%
    ggplot()+
    geom_area_pattern(aes(x=Year,y=value,fill=energy,pattern=is_elec),pattern_density=0.01)+
    scale_pattern_manual(values = c("non_elec" = "stripe", "elec" = "none"))+
    mytheme+
    scale_fill_manual(values=present_colours)+
    theme(legend.box = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "cm"))+
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        # override.aes = list(pattern = "stripe"))
        override.aes = list(pattern_spacing = 0.01,
                            pattern = c( rep("none",nb_elec),rep("stripe",nb_notelec))),
                          ncol=4),
      pattern = "none" # Disable the separate pattern legend
    )  +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(2020,2030,2040,2050))+
    labs(fill="",y=y_label,x="")
    
   if(!is.na(max_q)){
         g<-
           g+
           coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,max_q))
   }
  
   
  
  # print(g+canvas(10,4,"in"))
  return(g)
  
}
```

```{r}
create_combined_legend <- function(df_merged,scenario_filter,ncol_exo=6){

  df_q%>% filter(!is.na(value))%>%
    ggplot()+
     geom_ribbon(aes(x=Year,ymin=0,ymax=500,fill="[q10, q90]"),alpha=0.3)+
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=Year,ymin=500,ymax=1000,fill="[q25, q75]"),alpha=0.3)+
    geom_area_pattern(aes(x=Year,y=value,fill=energy,pattern=is_elec),pattern_density=0.01)+

    scale_pattern_manual(values = c("non_elec" = "stripe", "elec" = "none"))+
    mytheme+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(present_colours,"[q10, q90]"="lightblue",
                             "[q25, q75]"="navy"))+
    theme(legend.box = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "cm"))+

guides(
  fill = guide_legend(  ncol=ncol_exo,
    override.aes = list(pattern_spacing = 0.01,
                        pattern = pattern_override)),
  pattern = "none" # Disable the separate pattern legend
  )+
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(2020,2030,2040,2050))+
    labs(fill="",y="",x="")
  plot_legend+canvas(12,5,"in")
  g_legend<-get_legend(plot_legend)

return(g_legend)
  
}


plot_p_q_cumAhat<-function(df_merged,is_useful=F,scenario_filter = "Balanced Net Zero Pathway",legend=T){
  
  
# Quantities
g_q<-plot_energy_mix(df_merged,is_useful=is_useful,scenario_filter = scenario_filter)
if(is_useful){
  g_q<-g_q+labs(title="Useful Energy mix")}else{
    g_q<-g_q+labs(title="Final Energy mix") 
  }

# Productivity
df_aihat<-compute_Ahat(df_merged)
df_cumaihat<-compute_cumulative_Ahat(df_aihat)
g_ahat<-plot_cumulative_ahat(df_cumaihat,scenario_filter =scenario_filter)+labs(title="Cumulative productivity \ngrowth")

# Price
g_p<-plot_average_price_energy(df_aihat,is_useful=is_useful,scenario_filter = scenario_filter)+labs(title="Average price USD/MWh")



legend_q <- get_legend(g_q)
legend_A <- get_legend(g_ahat)

g_q<-g_q+theme(legend.position = "None")
g_ahat<-g_ahat+theme(legend.position = "None")

legend_combined<-create_combined_legend(df_merged,scenario_filter = scenario_filter)

g_x<-ggarrange(g_q,g_p,g_ahat,widths=c(1,1,1),nrow=1)
if(legend){
g_x<-ggarrange(g_x, ncol=1,legend.grob = legend_combined,legend="bottom",heights = c(5,2))
print(g_x)}else{
print(g_x)
}


}



```

```{r,fig.height=12,fig.width=12}
plot_multiple_scenarios<-function(df_plot_energy,scenario_ref_p,name_file){
  
  
df_aihat<-compute_Ahat(df_plot_energy)
df_cumaihat<-compute_cumulative_Ahat(df_aihat)%>%filter(Year<=2050)%>%
  left_join(df_quantiles_error_extended%>%mutate(Year=2022+horizon),by="Year")%>%
    mutate(q10=cum_Ahat+q10,
           q25=cum_Ahat+q25,
           q75=cum_Ahat+q75,
           q90=cum_Ahat+q90)%>%
  mutate(cum_Ahat=transform_bp_into_pp(cum_Ahat),
         q10=transform_bp_into_pp(q10),
         q25=transform_bp_into_pp(q25),
         q75=transform_bp_into_pp(q75),
         q90=transform_bp_into_pp(q90))%>%
  select(Year,Scenario_q,cum_Ahat,q10,q25,q75,q90)%>%
  gather(key=var,value=value,-c(1:2))

  p_min<-min(df_aihat$p)
  p_max<-max(df_aihat$p)
  cumAhat_min<-min(df_cumaihat$value)
  cumAhat_max<-max(df_cumaihat$value)
  
  
  
p_2022_way<-
  df_aihat%>%
  filter(Scenario_q==scenario_ref_p)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(Year==2022)%>%
  select(p)%>%
  summarise(p=mean(p))

p_2050_way<-
  df_aihat%>%
  filter(Scenario_q==scenario_ref_p)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(Year==2050)%>%
  group_by(Scenario_q,Year)%>%
  summarise(p=p)

for (x in unique(df_plot_energy$Scenario_q)){
  
  
  data=df_plot_energy%>%
    filter(Scenario_q==x)

   name_x=unique(data$Scenario_q_name)
  
  # Quantities
g_q<-plot_energy_mix(data,is_useful=T,scenario_filter = x)

  g_q<-g_q+labs(subtitle="Useful Energy mix")

# Productivity
df_aihat<-compute_Ahat(data)
df_cumaihat<-compute_cumulative_Ahat(df_aihat)
g_ahat<-plot_cumulative_ahat(df_cumaihat,scenario_filter =x)+labs(subtitle="Cumulative productivity growth")

# Price
g_p<-plot_average_price_energy(df_aihat,is_useful=T,scenario_filter = x)+
  labs(subtitle="Average price USD/useful MWh")+
  ylim(p_min,p_max)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = p_2022_way$p,colour="black",linetype=2)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = p_2050_way$p,colour="black",linetype=2)



legend_q <- get_legend(g_q)
legend_A <- get_legend(g_ahat)

g_q<-g_q+theme(legend.position = "None")
g_ahat<-g_ahat+theme(legend.position = "None")+
       scale_y_continuous(
        labels = scales::number_format(scale = 100, suffix = '%'),limits=c(cumAhat_min,cumAhat_max))

legend_combined<-create_combined_legend(data,scenario_filter = x,ncol_exo=8)
  
  g_x<-ggarrange(g_q,g_p,g_ahat,widths=c(1,1,1),nrow=1)
    g_x <- annotate_figure(g_x,
                         top = text_grob(name_x, 
                                         color = "black", face = "bold", size = 12))
  

# print(g_x)
  assign(paste("g",x,sep="_"),g_x)
  
  }
  
n_scenarios<-n_distinct(df_plot_energy$Scenario_q)

 list_scenario<-unique(df_plot_energy$Scenario_q)
 # Create a list of ggplot objects from the scenario names
plot_list <- mget(paste0("g_", list_scenario))

# Arrange them vertically with shared legend
g_useful_energy <- do.call(ggarrange, append(
  plot_list,
  list(ncol = 1, legend = "bottom", legend.grob = legend_combined)
))

# g_useful_energy<-ggarrange(get(paste("g",list_scenario[1],sep="_")),
#                           get(paste("g",list_scenario[3],sep="_")),
#                            get(paste("g",list_scenario[2],sep="_")),
#                           ncol=1,legend.grob = legend_combined,legend="bottom")

h=11.5/3*n_scenarios+0.5
print(g_useful_energy+canvas(12,h,"in"))

ggsave(g_useful_energy,file=file.path(graph_path,name_file),width=12,height=h)

}
```

Average price of electricity
For the UK: current price of electricity is about 75 GDP/MWh
In 2023, 94 GPB/MWh. 
See: https://grid.iamkate.com/


https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/annual-domestic-energy-price-statistics#history
Table 2.2.4
Average UK Overall: Average variable unit price:  0.30£/kWh
NESO/ https://www.neso.energy/energy-101/electricity-explained/how-electricity-priced
wholesale price elec make up 39% of consumer price
Hence, wholesale cost UK in 2022 0.30*0.39=117 £/MWh

## BZN - focus wind

Diagnostic
gas+CCC, biomass+CCS (4.8% of total final energy in BZN, 6.1% in Headwind)
These two technologies appear in 2026-2027.
```{r}
df_q_CCC <- prepare_quantity_data_CCC(read_CCC_scenario_sheet(input_file, "Quantity"))
dfp_fast_transition <- df_prices_energy%>%filter(Scenario_p=="Fast_Transition")
df_p <- prepare_price_data(dfp_fast_transition)
df_CCC <- merge_price_quantity_and_add_network(df_q_CCC, df_p, cost_add = 7)


df_CCC%>%
  filter(Year==2050)%>%
  filter(variable=="q")%>%
  group_by(Year,Scenario_q)%>%
  mutate(value=value/sum(value))%>%
  filter(energy %in% c("elec_gas_CCS","elec_biomass_CCS"))%>%
  spread(key=energy,value=value)%>%
  select(-Scenario_p,-Year)%>%
  mutate(total=elec_gas_CCS+elec_biomass_CCS)


df_CCC%>% 
  filter(variable=="q")%>%
  filter(energy %in% c("elec_gas_CCS","elec_biomass_CCS"))%>%
  filter(value>0)%>%
  group_by(energy,Scenario_q)%>%
  summarise(minyear=min(Year),.groups = "drop")%>%
  spread(key=energy,value=minyear)
```

Replacing  gas+CCC, biomass+CCS by offshore wind, we bump productivity

```{r}

dfq_BZN_wind <- read_CCC_scenario_sheet(input_file, "Quantity")%>%
  filter(Scenario_q=="Balanced Net Zero Pathway")%>%
  # replace gas_CCS with wind
  mutate(wind_offshore=wind_offshore+elec_gas_CCS+elec_biomass_CCS,
         elec_gas_CCS=0,
         elec_biomass_CCS=0)

df_q_wind <- prepare_quantity_data_CCC(dfq_BZN_wind)
```

```{r}
# 2. Take marginal cost (current-year p)

  rename(p_marginal = p) %>%
  select(Year, energy, Scenario_p, p_marginal)

# 3. Align scenario names (Scenario_q vs Scenario_p) if needed

  left_join(p_marg,
            by = c("Year","energy","Scenario_p" = "Scenario_p"))

# 4. Compute difference
comp <- comp %>%

  filter(Scenario_p=="Fast_Transition",energy=="solar",Year<=2050)%>%
```

```{r}
# Compare total cost
compute_cost<-function(df){
convert_EJ_to_TWh(df)%>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022,2050))%>%
  group_by(Scenario_q,Year)%>%
  spread(key=variable,value=value)%>%
  # q TWh * p USD/MWh = 10^6 USD, millions => /10^3 in billions
  summarise(cost=sum(q*p,na.rm=T)/10^3)%>%
  spread(key=Scenario_q,value=cost)
}


compute_cost(df_merged_way_useful)
compute_cost(df_merged_way_useful_vintage)


convert_EJ_to_TWh(df_merged_way_useful_vintage)%>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2050),Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition")%>%
  group_by(Scenario_q,Year,energy)%>%
  spread(key=variable,value=value)%>%
  mutate(q=ifelse(energy %in% c("solar","wind"),q*1.4,q))%>%
  # q TWh * p USD/MWh = 10^6 USD, millions => /10^3 in billions
  summarise(cost=sum(q*p,na.rm=T)/10^3)%>%
  arrange(-cost)
```

Way
```{r}
Way_useful_energy_raw<-read_way_scenario_sheet(sheet="useful_energy")%>%
  mutate(Scenario_q = str_replace_all(Scenario_q, "_Way", ""))%>%
  mutate(Scenario_q = str_replace_all(Scenario_q, "transition", "Transition"))
Way_useful_energy_raw<-prepare_quantity_data_way(Way_useful_energy_raw)
# quantities
```

```{r}
table(Fast_Way_useful$energy)
```


We are transforming the Balanced Net Zero scenario into Way scenario. We use the final mix of WIMF (including a lot of solar).
We use the next section where we correct for wind and solar ratio.




```{r}
# Final energy mix in Way (useful) in %
Way_fast_transition_share<-
 Fast_Way_useful%>%
  filter(Year==2050)%>%
  group_by(Scenario_q,Year)%>%
  mutate(value=q/sum(q))


# add energy at 0 to match Way scenario: elec_coal
# Way_fast_transition_share%>%
  # filter(!energy %in% c(unique(df_BZN_useful$energy))
unique((df_BZN_useful%>%
  filter(!energy %in% unique(Way_fast_transition_share$energy)))$energy)
# create the energy
df_BZN_eleccoal<-
  df_BZN_useful%>%
  filter(energy=="elec_unabated_gas")%>%
  mutate(energy="elec_coal")%>%
  spread(key=variable,value=value)
df_BZN_eleccoal$q<-0
df_BZN_eleccoal<-
  df_BZN_eleccoal%>%
  select(-p)%>%
  left_join(df_merged_way_useful%>%
              filter(energy=="elec_coal" & variable=="p" & Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition")%>%
                             filter(!is.na(value))%>%
                                      rename("p"="value")%>%
                                      select(Year,p),by="Year")
  
  df_BZN_eleccoal<-
    df_BZN_eleccoal%>%
    gather(key=variable,value=value,-c("Scenario_q","Unit","Year","energy","Scenario_p","ratio_2022","x_final_useful"))
# add it to the existing
df_BZN_Way<-
  rbind(df_BZN_useful,
        df_BZN_eleccoal
        )

# Total energy in BZN (useful) in TWh
q_total_final_2050<-
  df_BZN_Way%>%
  filter(Year==2050)%>%
  filter(variable=="q")%>%
  group_by(Scenario_q,Year)%>%
  summarise(total_energy=sum(value),.groups = "drop")

# Initial point in 2026 in TWh in UK 
q_initial<- 
  df_BZN_Way%>%
  filter(Year<2026)%>%
  filter(variable=="q")%>%
  mutate(Scenario_q="Fast_Transition_UK")%>%
  select(Scenario_q,energy,Year,value)


# Construct: final energy mix (useful) UK in TWh
q_final<-
 Way_fast_transition_share%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(value=value*q_total_final_2050$total_energy)%>%
  select(energy,Year,value)%>%
  mutate(Year=as.numeric(Year))

  
# Construct: Gather Initial (2020-2025) and final (2050) energy mix
q_fast_way<-
  q_initial%>%
  spread(key=Year,value=value)%>%
  left_join(q_final%>%
  spread(key=Year,value=value))%>%
  gather(key=Year,value=value,-c(1:2))%>%
  mutate(value=ifelse(is.na(value),0,value))%>%
  mutate(Year=as.numeric(Year))
  
# Construct: linear progression of energy mix between 2025 and 2050
pq_fast_way <- 
  q_fast_way %>%
  group_by(Scenario_q, energy) %>% # Group by scenario, variable, and energy category
  complete(Year = 2026:2050) %>% # Create rows for each year between 2026 and 2049 (included)
  arrange(energy, Year) %>%
  # linear completion
  mutate(value = if_else(is.na(value), 
                         approx(Year[!is.na(value)], value[!is.na(value)], xout = Year)$y, 
                         value)) %>%
  rename("q"="value")%>%
  mutate(variable="q")
df_p <- prepare_price_data(dfp_fast_transition)

pq_fast_way <- merge_price_quantity_and_add_network(pq_fast_way%>%filter(variable=="q"), df_p, cost_add = 7)
pq_fast_way<-convert_p_final_to_useful(pq_fast_way)%>%
  mutate(Unit="TWh")

pq_fast_way%>%
  filter(variable=="q")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=value))+
  geom_line(lwd=1)+
  facet_wrap(~energy,scales="free")+
  theme_minimal()
```

## UK way with more wind than solar

in Way: the ratio between wind and solar in 2050 is 0.46
```{r}
qs=Way_useful_energy_raw%>%filter(Year==2050 & energy=="solar" & Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition")%>%select(q)
qw=Way_useful_energy_raw%>%filter(Year==2050 & energy=="wind_offshore" & Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition")%>%select(q)
qw/qs
```

In Balanced Net Zero, the ratio is 5.16 in 2050. 
```{r}
ratio_qw_qs<-df_BZN_Way%>%
  filter(Scenario_q=="Balanced Net Zero Pathway" &
           variable=="q"&
           Year==2050 & 
           energy %in% c("solar","wind_offshore","wind_onshore"))%>%
  select(-ratio_2022,-x_final_useful)%>%
  spread(key=energy,value=value)%>%
  mutate(wind=wind_offshore+wind_onshore)%>%
  mutate(ratio_qw_qs=wind/solar)%>%
  select(ratio_qw_qs)
ratio_qw_qs
```

If we want to replicate the CCC BZN ratio of wind and solar (5.16) in UK Way, we transfer a share x of solar to wind
$\frac{W+xS}{S(1-x)}=R=5.16$
Hence, 
$x=-\frac{W-R\cdotS}{S(R+1)}$
x=0.76

```{r}
R=ratio_qw_qs$ratio_qw_qs
S=qs$q
W=qw$q

x=-(W-R*S)/(S*(1+R))
x

# CHECK
(W+x*S)/(S*(1-x))
# 

```

```{r}
# Construct: linear progression of energy mix between 2025 and 2050
pq_fast_way <- 
  q_fast_way %>%
  group_by(Scenario_q, energy) %>% # Group by scenario, variable, and energy category
  complete(Year = 2026:2050) %>% # Create rows for each year between 2026 and 2049 (included)
  arrange(energy, Year) %>%
  # linear completion
  mutate(value = if_else(is.na(value), 
                         approx(Year[!is.na(value)], value[!is.na(value)], xout = Year)$y, 
                         value)) %>%
  rename("q"="value")%>%
  mutate(variable="q")
```

3. Price:  1700
Note that the final prices are not exactly equal, 
it is due to difference in the price of solar and wind due to the price of network
Since the network is less developped in the world than in the UK in 2022, 
it means that the development of new capacities in renewables cost more in network
The difference are marginal: from 18.14 to 18.09 (UK) in solar, and from 29.49 (world) 
to 29.28 (UK) for wind
(see below)

## Coal elec price

We may have overestimated the cost of coal elecricity by taking the new generation of coal plant in the UK (see table)

The cost of coal elec in BEIS without coal cost, carbon cost and CCS is 136 -17-6-24=89 £
```{r}
p_coal_elec_nofuel<-89*exchange_rate_UK_US*1.13 #conversion USD 2014 to USD2020
p_coal_elec_nofuel
```
That is 124 2020 USD/MWh. 

We add the cost of coal: 6.725517 2020USD/MWh
```{r}
df_prices_energy%>%
  filter(energy=="solid" & Year %in% c(2022,2050))
p_coal<-
  (df_prices_energy%>%
  filter(energy=="solid" & Year==2050 & Scenario_p=="Fast_Transition"))$value
```

compute
```{r}
compute_Ahat(df_merged_way_useful)%>%
  filter(Scenario_q=="Fast_Transition" & Year==2050)%>%
  select(p)

```


COnversion from primary to electricity is 0.4
```{r}
p_coal_elec_nofuel+p_coal/0.4
```
That is 140 2020 USD/MWh

Instead of 168, which is the value we use. 


What would be the impact on Way et al ?
33 EJ at most, on average 13.5 EJ/year

## Total Cost

Total cost
```{r}
convert_EJ_to_TWh(df_merged_way_useful)%>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022,2050))%>%
  group_by(Scenario_q,Year)%>%
  spread(key=variable,value=value)%>%
  # q is in TWh, p in USD/MWh, p*10^6 is in USD/TWh
  # q*p*10^6 is in USD
  # Diving by 10^12: trillion of USD
  summarise(cost=sum(q*p*10^6)/10^12)%>%
  spread(key=Scenario_q,value=cost)
```
Note that we do not find the total cost given by Way et al, resp 8. 5tr USD/yr for No Transition, and 5.3 for the Fast transition in 2050. That is a yearly difference of 3.2 tr USD/yr compared to baseline for FT.
